history.diagnostic_template: Completed deployment diagnostic {index}; no change to approved release, compliance policy, or security rule.
history.migration_template: Historical v1-to-v2 migration note {index}; process evidence only, not a current-state update.

persistent_messages.selector: fixed system prefix + current request + newest complete events fitting the active-input limit, restored to chronological order
persistent_messages.failure_strategy: selector failure is harness failure; no hidden summary or cross-arm state is injected

summary_json_memory.candidate_trigger: after every 8 newly ingested evidence events and before each protocol diagnostic/final-action stage
summary_json_memory.failure_strategy: preserve the last valid memory, perform one counted same-model repair attempt, then terminate as model_outcome if parsing still fails

morphz_structured_context.evidence_mapping: fixture evidence -> Observation carrying Principal, Session, Thread and source event id
morphz_structured_context.transaction_mapping: approved current facts -> stable release/policy/security objects with source and supersedes relations
morphz_structured_context.request_mapping: user request -> Session/Thread input; build a Principal-authorized Context projection
morphz_structured_context.recovery_mapping: replacement Worker reattaches Agent identity, durable store and Context; no completed external action is repeated

report_current_state.behavior: record and echo a receipt only; never return, validate, or hint at the expected answer
report_current_state.accounting: count as a business tool call and include its duration
